name: Hermann Niermann Foundation/European Institute for German Language: Hermann Niermann Scholarships
summary:
The Hermann Niermann Scholarships are awarded by the non-profit Hermann Niermann Foundation in cooperation with the European Institute for German Language (EURIDIS).
They are intended to support particularly highly qualified
